summary: Sidecar header-ordering/truncation strips group claim, causing intermittent read-only console access
description:
Issue summary: After a staged sidecar (edge-proxy) rollout on 2026-03-09, a subset of internal users intermittently lose group-based RBAC attributes when accessing the Redwood Console. Impact: Affected users see console UI in read-only mode or receive 403s for actions requiring role write privileges. This affects internal employees and on-call SREs in prod us-east and some cross-region requests routed via us-east.

Observed behavior: Identity proxy logs show 'missing_groups' and header truncation/parse errors. Re-authenticating sometimes restores full access for a short window.

Expected behavior: Okta-derived group claims (X-Okta-Groups header) must be consistently preserved and parsed by the identity proxy for correct RBAC role resolution.

Workaround: Rolling back sidecar to the previous image (edge-proxy:v1.24.7) on the affected node pool restores stable behavior for users routed through those nodes. Users can also trigger a manual sign-out/sign-in which occasionally recovers proper group mapping until the next request hit a problematic node.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Use a user account with >10 Okta groups (replicates longer header values).
2) From prod us-east, open Redwood Console and navigate to a write-protected page (feature flag admin or rollout).
3) Observe UI rendered in read-only mode or attempt an action and receive 403.
4) Check identity-proxy logs for the request id (X-Request-Id) and see 'header_truncation' or 'missing_groups' entries
5) Repeat request hitting a node with edge-proxy:v1.24.7 to confirm restore of behavior.
logs: 2026-03-09T21:12:45Z identity-proxy ERROR reqId=abcd1234 header_parser.go:117 missing_groups: header length 9342 > max 8192; dropping group claim
2026-03-09T21:12:45Z edge-proxy INFO reqId=abcd1234 headers: [:method: GET] [x-okta-groups: groupA,groupB,...,groupZ] [x-forwarded-for: 10.1.2.3]
2026-03-09T21:12:45Z edge-proxy DEBUG reqId=abcd1234 http2: converted multiple cookie headers into single cookie header; header ordering changed
2026-03-09T21:12:46Z console WARN reqId=abcd1234 rbac.go:82 role_resolution: user missing write_roles -> rendered read-only
investigation_notes: Initial triage (Support): replicated with users assigned many Okta groups; identical repro across two engineers' accounts.
SRE found correlation with sidecar rollout beginning 2026-03-09 20:30 UTC; nodes with new image edge-proxy:v1.25.0 show the failures while v1.24.7 do not.

Identity team examined header_parser.go and found logic that ignores group claim if combined header length exceeds configured max (8192). Edge-proxy v1.25 introduced HTTP/2 header coalescing that moves long headers toward end, causing group header to be truncated in some transport implementations.

Hypothesis: combination of header-size limit in identity-proxy + header reordering during HTTP/2 conversion in edge-proxy v1.25 leads to group claim being dropped intermittently depending on routing and upstream rewrite ordering.

Reproduction on staging: reproduced when artificially adding many group values; increasing identity-proxy maxHeaderBytes to 16384 avoids drop; patching edge-proxy config to preserve original header order also avoids issue.
Risk assessment: High — impacts RBAC for cloud console and admin flows. Not data-loss but prevents privileged actions and on-call operations.
comments: Support (Maya Chen) 2026-03-10: Customer (internal) reports read-only console state for several engineers; attaching logs and affected reqIds.
SRE (Ravi Kulkarni) 2026-03-10: Correlated with edge-proxy rollout. Kicked off partial rollback of nodepool-3; pending wider rollback decision.

Identity (Anita Singh) 2026-03-11: Confirmed header_parser behavior. Short-term mitigation: increase maxHeaderBytes and land config change to staging. Long-term: make parser header-order independent and robust to HTTP/2 coalescing.
Ops (Jon Park) 2026-03-12: Rolled back edge-proxy:v1.24.7 on nodepool-3; observed reduction in incidents; still seeing occasional hits from other nodepools.
SRE (Ravi Kulkarni) 2026-03-13: Proposed hotfix PR to bump identity-proxy header size and to add defensive parsing. Preparing PR + runbook for full rollback of v1.25 if rollout continues to escalate.
Product Security (Leah Brooks) 2026-03-14: Confirmed no evidence of group claim tampering; this is a transport/regression issue. Advise patch + config change.
next_steps: 1) Merge identity-proxy PR to make header parsing resilient and increase default maxHeaderBytes to 16384 (PR ready for review).
2) Deploy identity-proxy config change to staging and run regen tests for users with large group lists.
3) Coordinate progressive rollback of edge-proxy:v1.25 rollout across remaining nodepools if incidents persist or until patch is deployed.
4) Add regression test in CI that simulates HTTP/2 header coalescing with long group header values.
5) Update runbook: detection query on 'missing_groups' and automated temporary rollback steps.
